pc_specificity.description: Fresh source MediaDive2082 names generic L-alpha-phosphatidylcholine, CAS8002-43-5, complex_compound=1 and no molecular formula/ChEBI. CHEBI:86658 is a defined C42H80NO8P 16:0/(9E,12E)18:2 molecule. Prior label/MW/Greek-alias review did not establish this acyl identity; the new structural alias makes the over-specificity explicit. No guessed replacement.
